title: Comfortable but weighs a ton
text:
Comfortable but weighs a ton. When I first got this blanket, I have to admit that I was pretty confused because I didn't read the listing before I got it. I was expecting it to be a knit braided blanket like the ones you see all over Pinterest and Instagram that look like they would be these big fluffy clouds that you could wrap around you. However, once I opened it up and got a good look at it, it wasn't what I was expecting at all, but I am kinda in love with it anyway. First, it is as heavy as everything. It is very very heavy, almost like it should be a weighted blanket. I am okay with that but not everyone wants a weighted blanket like this. Also, as the listing says, it is not a lightweight blanket at all and I would not put this in my washing machine either because of the weight of it.

Overall, this blanket is huge, feels good, isn't as soft as I was expecting but it works, weighs a ton but otherwise pretty comfortable.
